name: press_all_buttons
description: Every switch closed at once: rails unmoved, buttons at ground

assert.name: a pressed button reads as ground
the battery rail is untouched by the switches
assert.because: SW16's shell tabs carry BTN_SELECT; welding them to BAT+ is the bug this asserts against

assert.name: eleven buttons have a computable debounce RC
assert.because: BTN_L is the twelfth and must NOT have one — R14 is DNP because GPIO45 is a strapping pin

assert.name: the slowest release edge is under 2 ms
assert.because: a firmware debounce interval shorter than this reads a release as a second press
